ru: Нажми кнопку — назначь клавишу, мышь или колесо. Esc — отмена.
en: Click a bind, then press a key, mouse button or wheel. Esc cancels.

ru: Ищем вазу, которая ещё не в осколках…
en: Looking for a vase that isn't shards yet…

ru: Клеим скотч на скотч на скотч…
en: Taping tape onto tape onto tape…
The bald hunter is already overbidding…
The pot is not a saucepan. Checking…
Paddle is crooked, bid is straight…
Dust won't come off. Once more…
Hamster in the bag. Do not shake…
Loading a dresser as a team, solo…
Cops are already rolling. Or not…
The vendor is yelling. That's normal…

ru: Ищем ключ от сейфа в сейфе…
en: Looking for the safe key inside the safe…
Paint on your buddy is drying…
Car on bumps. Hold the vase…
The casino is fair. Ha. Loading…
Pulling bills out of the pot…
Caretaker is yelling about the broom…
The unicorn is climbing into the truck…
One more second and you can scream…
